text:
maya: Quick sync: planning a community tutorial series + micro OSS launch week. Goals: 3 tutorials, 1 reference app demo, 1 mini webinar, social + benchmark narrative. Owners needed for benchmark narrative, webinar script, lead routing. Thoughts?

sam: Love it. Timeline idea: drafts by next Tue. Webinar Wed 2pm PT? :calendar: 

jordan: @maya I'll own tutorials + refapp. Need baseline benchmarks — can @kyle run p95 latency and throughput vs hosted API? Also want cost delta.

kyle: Yep. I'll run perf sweep on dedicated. ETA EOD Fri. Will post here. Example command:
```bash
python perf_runner.py --model redwood-3b --batch 8 --seq 512
```

olga: I can mock landing hero + tweet cards. Need final title + key stat by Mon. Figma: https://figma.com/... 

maya: Messaging draft: "Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference costs." Open to edits.

sam: Benchmark narrative note: focus on dev workloads — chat + embeddings rerank. Show end-to-end latency and cost per 1M tokens. Call out caching/batching impact.

jordan: Webinar format: 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A. Preselect 3 dev questions. I'll draft script and ask @kyle for demo snippets (with/without caching).

kyle: I'll create two snippets: no-cache vs cache. Example payload:
```json
{\"prompt\": \"Summarize the following...\", \"cache\": false}
```

maya: Inbound lead routing: @sam can you set UTMs and a webhook to SFDC sandbox? Mapping: utm_campaign=community-launch, source=twitter, medium=webinar. Assign follow-up owner.

sam: On it. UTM template:
`/signup?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=community-launch&utm_content=tutorial`

launch-bot: Reminder: calendar event for Wed 2pm PT — attendees: maya, jordan, kyle, olga, sam.

olga: I'll prep hero images by Mon noon. Need primary benchmark stat from @kyle asap.

kyle: Posted initial numbers: p95=120ms on redwood-3b (dedicated). Cost estimate ~$0.012/token (rough). Will refine.

maya: Perfect. I'll draft launch post + dev thread for X. Dropping drafts Mon 10am. Thanks all :rocket:
